scope: Connected active DropMove/MoveRename/DropCopyAdd command family, captured source/target identity and permissions, destination adoption, explicit automatic execution, native source prompts/progress/cancellation and owning preferences.
implementation: Typed internal Drop Move/Copy Add actions preserve separate raw source list and required destination; Move accepts optional rename. Sources/target survive authorized path-file resolution and adoption selection. Missing arguments fail before list deletion. Source administrative paths and Copy/Add destination-self are filtered; native exact ordered unique source identity remains.

Captured native preparation authorizes the destination working tree, resolves linked metadata before Git, validates its working folder and same-working-tree tracked Move sources before any operation window. Original window cancellation/retirement suppresses late preparation/adoption. Pending work retains busy/Quit ownership until actual drain.

Destination adoption uses the existing normal workspace transaction and captured owner. The subsequent operation captures the original sources and owning preferences rather than interpreting sources relative to a later destination workspace. After adoption, the operation uses the adopted repository and final composite access lease, including any additional metadata grants acquired by that transaction.

Explicit commands begin native progress after preflight. Move uses optional Rename, collision name sheets, ordered Ignore/Abort and original Rename artwork; Copy/Add uses original Add artwork, external-source permission, Overwrite/Keep/Cancel, copied repository/submodule Delete/Ignore/Abort and final batch Add. Existing app menu, clipboard and drop-sheet entries retain their review.

Move asynchronous source/destination preparation has a default-off automatic continuation, guarded by its live operation owner after preparation settles. Closing a window before late permission/read completion cannot begin mutation. Existing operation windows retain grants and active counters until actual drain.

Shared Move and Copy/Add helpers now forward owning preferences and permit native presentation/source-grant injection for grouped verification. Command windows stay independent; no prior transfer draft is overwritten.
